figures.name: Potnia

ability.name: Snake Goddess's Power
ability.description: All snake and earth enemies lose 3 stats; allies gain +2 magic and defense.

figures.description: The supreme Minoan goddess who holds serpents in each hand and governs all of nature's cycles.

figures.name: Asterion the Minotaur

ability.name: Maze Heart
ability.description: Create a labyrinth: enemy abilities have a 50% chance to get lost and fail each turn.

figures.description: The Minotaur at the heart of the labyrinth, born of divine punishment and fed with Athenian sacrifices.

figures.name: Britomartis

ability.name: Net of the Hunt
ability.description: Immobilize one enemy for 2 turns; they cannot dodge or reposition.

figures.description: Virgin Cretan goddess of hunting and fishing nets who leapt into the sea to escape King Minos.

figures.name: Eileithyia

ability.name: Birth Cave
ability.description: Restore a fallen ally to play with half HP; they enter fully healed of all debuffs.

figures.description: Ancient cave goddess of childbirth whose presence or absence determined whether labor could proceed.

figures.name: Velchanos

ability.name: Sacred Tree
ability.description: Regenerate 2 HP per turn for 3 turns; allies gain +2 to one random stat.

figures.description: Young Minoan sky god who takes the form of a bird or young man and dwells in the sacred tree.

figures.name: Dionysus of Crete

ability.name: Bull Dance Frenzy
ability.description: Inflict ecstasy on all enemies; your side gains +3 power for 1 turn.

figures.description: The Cretan form of Dionysus connected to the sacred bull and ecstatic rites predating the Greek version.

figures.name: Europa

ability.name: Bull of Heaven
ability.description: Summon a divine bull ally with 8/8/6/5/5 stats for 2 turns.

figures.description: Goddess or princess carried across the sea by Zeus in bull form, whose name means 'wide-gazing' like the full moon.

figures.name: Ariadne

ability.name: Thread of Ariadne
ability.description: Allow one ally to escape any trap or debuff; grant them +2 to all stats.

figures.description: Cretan princess whose golden thread guided heroes through the labyrinth; later divine mistress of the moon.

figures.name: Pasiphae

ability.name: Moon Enchantment
ability.description: Inflict love-madness on one enemy: they protect this card instead of attacking for 1 turn.

figures.description: Moon goddess and daughter of the sun whose divine madness was inflicted by Poseidon's wrath.

figures.name: Talos

ability.name: Bronze Patrol
ability.description: Deal 4 damage to all enemies attempting to approach; prevent all landing or entry abilities.

figures.description: Bronze mechanical giant forged by Hephaestus who ran around Crete three times a day to repel invaders.

figures.name: Labyrinth Daemon

ability.name: Winding Path
ability.description: Swap all enemies' positions randomly; each loses 1 speed for 1 turn.

figures.description: The genius loci of the great Labyrinth, spirit of confusion and divine mystery built by Daedalus.

figures.name: The Labrys

ability.name: Double Strike
ability.description: Attack twice in one turn, each strike dealing 3 damage.

figures.description: Divine spirit of the double-headed sacred axe, symbol of the Minoan religion and divine female power.

figures.name: Nymphs of Ida

ability.name: Sacred Honey
ability.description: Restore 3 HP to all allies at the start of battle.

figures.description: Divine nymphs who nursed the infant Zeus in the cave of Mount Ida and fed him sacred honey.

figures.name: Glaukos

ability.name: Honey Resurrection
ability.description: Resurrect one fallen ally at 3 HP using the knowledge of a divine herb.

figures.description: Prince who drowned in a honey jar and was resurrected by the seer Polyidus using a magical herb.

figures.name: Daedalus

ability.name: Architect's Wings
ability.description: Grant one ally temporary flight: they cannot be targeted for 1 turn.

figures.description: Master craftsman who built the Labyrinth, fashioned wings of wax and feathers, and flew to freedom.

figures.name: Curetes

ability.name: War Dance
ability.description: Create enough noise to cancel one enemy's summon or ambush ability.

figures.description: Divine warrior dancers who clashed their spears against their shields to drown out the infant Zeus's crying.

figures.name: Bull of Minos

ability.name: Sacred Bull Charge
ability.description: Deal 6 damage to one target; 30% chance to stun all adjacent enemies.

figures.description: The divine bull sent by Poseidon whose untamed rage led to the creation of the Minotaur.

figures.name: Minoans Sea Spirit

ability.name: Dolphin's Path
ability.description: All ally cards gain +2 speed and cannot be intercepted this turn.

figures.description: The divine protector spirit of Minoan seafarers who appears as a dolphin guiding ships through safe waters.

figures.name: Mountain Mother

ability.name: Lion Throne
ability.description: Summon a lion guardian: absorb the next 5 damage dealt to any ally.

figures.description: The great mountain goddess who sits enthroned between lions, mistress of all wild high places in Crete.

figures.name: Phaistos Disc Spirit

ability.name: Undeciphered
ability.description: Randomly copy one ability from any card on the field and use it immediately.

figures.description: The unknowable spirit encoded in the still-undeciphered spiral inscription of the Phaistos Disc.
